name: dex
description: Suivi des courriers sortants - Secrétariat Central

scripts.dev: start "frontend" cmd /c npm run dev --workspace=frontend && start "backend" cmd /c npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend
scripts.db:init: npm run db:apply --workspace=backend && npm run db:seed --workspace=backend
scripts.preview:prod: npm run build && npm run db:init && npm run start
